description: Cosmophiles is a team passionate about astronomy, astrophysics, and exploring the mysteries of our universe. We’re tackling NASA’s Planet X and SPHEREx challenge by developing an interactive tool to explore astronomical observations and investigate celestial objects that move or change over time. We’re looking for curious minds, especially web developers (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), Python developers, and astronomy enthusiasts. Let’s learn, collaborate, and build something meaningful together!
